integrity: Complete all-size mathematical argument, credited classical coupon-singleton pmf; independent exact-rational finite verifier. Self-review only, not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact law is for a single exogenously fixed common favorite of a designated subset and independently uniform remaining rankings, unit-capacity schools and RSD; not arbitrary correlated rankings, multi-seat schools or deferred acceptance. Finite computation covers only n<=4.
